name: Rectangular dining table for terraces, restaurants, and outdoor use, sun and water resistant
material: powder coated aluminium frame w/t WPC board table top
description: Transform your outdoor spaces with this rectangular dining table , specially designed for terraces, hotels, restaurants, malls, patios, and bars. Its sturdiness and style make it the ideal complement for high-traffic areas and variable weather conditions in anywhere. The wood-plastic composite (a blend of wood fibers and plastic) top   provides a natural look and enhanced durability. The legs are made of  reinforced iron  for maximum stability.
